verdict.rationale: LiveKit describes itself as an open-source platform. Its server source is published on GitHub (github.com/livekit/livekit), and the agents frameworks have their own public Python and Node.js repos. The docs also say you can start on open source and move between it and Cloud. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g. Apache-2.0), and there is no independent corroboration of the license terms or which components are open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LiveKit is an open-source platform for building voice, video, and physical AI agents.
You can start on open source and migrate to LiveKit Cloud without rewriting application code.
